provenance: #7341 (2026-10-25/26) Kraus 1935 Arabic print: the gate's 4 pages (gate-rows.jsonl) + the whole-book stratified draw of 25 (scripts/eval/results/kraus-print-7341/kraus-rows.jsonl); one book. Three reads a page, judged blind by Opus and by Gemini 3.8 Flash (judge.py).
judge: claude-opus-5-5 (claude -p), judge.py USABLE / NOTICEABLE / MISLEADING / FAILED against the image; the Gemini judge's misleading count is recorded, not used. Opus judges its own read here (self-preference unmeasured).
mapping: wrong_text = MISLEADING; accept = USABLE or NOTICEABLE; FAILED (no read: agy filter cut / did_not_read) = not accepted, not wrong text

lite.served: gemini-3.1-flash-lite, production OCR prompt, temp 0.1 (paid API)

agy-flash-low-read-diplomatic.served: agy gemini-3.8-flash-low, the #6544 diplomatic READ prompt (not cli-ocr's live prompt: its own route), one page a call

opus-read.served: claude-opus-5-5 claude -p --restricted, the same diplomatic READ prompt, one page a call
